name: Ultra Trencher 1
def: Submersible trenching robot that buries undersea pipelines by cutting trenches in the seabed, described as the largest submersible robot in the world.
facts: Mass of 60 tons; 7.8 m long, 7.8 m wide and 5.6 m tall
Trenches pipelines up to 1 m in diameter at depths of up to 1,500 m
Cuts trenches with a pair of jet swords that force pressurised water into sediment
